items.name: utils
items.title: cn()
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge configured for the ws-* token scales. Every Wideset component imports it.

items.name: logic
items.title: Date helpers
items.description: Date formatting and range helpers shared by the date pickers, and number helpers (clamp, isFiniteNumber) shared by components.

items.name: icon-types
items.title: Icon types
items.description: Type for the Remix Icon components Wideset accepts as props.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: MotionProvider, the motion recipes and useShake: how components animate, and the switch that turns motion off.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme
items.description: Toggles the dark class on the document root.

items.name: styles
items.title: Wideset styles
items.description: Compiled tokens, component CSS and the Tailwind utilities components use. No reset, no font. Every component depends on it.
items.docs: Import it once in your app. Vite: `import '@/styles/wideset.css'` in main.tsx. Tailwind entry file: `@import './wideset.css';` next to your other imports.

items.name: skills
items.title: Wideset agent skills
items.description: Agent Skills for building with Wideset, for Codex, Cursor and other agents that read .agents/skills, plus AGENTS.wideset.md and a Cursor rule.
items.docs: Point your agent at the rules: add `See AGENTS.wideset.md for Wideset rules.` to AGENTS.md. `npx wideset skills` does this for you.

items.name: skills-claude
items.title: Wideset agent skills for Claude Code
items.description: The same Agent Skills in .claude/skills, where Claude Code reads them, plus the two reviewer agents.
items.docs: Import the rules from CLAUDE.md: add `@AGENTS.wideset.md`. `npx wideset skills` does this for you.

items.name: preflight
items.title: Wideset preflight
items.description: Tailwind's browser reset, for apps without Tailwind. Apps with Tailwind v4 already have it.
items.docs: Import it before wideset.css. Vite: `import '@/styles/wideset-preflight.css'` in main.tsx.

items.name: font
items.title: Wideset font
items.description: Variable Inter as the page font, self-hosted through Fontsource. wideset init adds it by default; skip it with --no-font to keep your own font.
items.docs: Import it once, after your other stylesheets. Vite: `import '@/styles/wideset-font.css'` in main.tsx.

items.name: theme
items.title: Wideset theme
items.description: Uncompiled @theme and @utility source for apps running Tailwind v4, so their own build compiles the ws-* classes. Add it next to styles: it has no element rules (font smoothing, 1em icon sizing) and no plugins; radix-* and animate-* classes need tailwindcss-radix and tailwindcss-animate.
items.docs: In your Tailwind entry file, after `@import 'tailwindcss';` add `@import './wideset-theme.css';` and `@plugin 'tailwindcss-radix'; @plugin 'tailwindcss-animate';`.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion organizes content into collapsible sections.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: ActionBar
items.description: ActionBar is a fixed floating toolbar that appears at the top or bottom of the screen, used to surface contextual actions when items are selected.

items.name: action-tile
items.title: ActionTile
items.description: ActionTile is a tile-shaped entry point to an action or a destination: an entity badge, a title and description, and a trailing arrow.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: AppShell is the full-height frame a screen sits in: the Sidebar and the page, in the app's visual direction (flat, frame or inset) set by one prop.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar represents a user with an image, initials, an icon, or the agent orb.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A navigation aid that shows the user's current location within a page hierarchy.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button triggers an action. Composes with Button.Icon and Button.TruncatedText.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar lets the user pick a single date or a date range.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card is a flexible surface for grouping related content, media, and actions into one container.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox allows users to select one or more items from a set.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Chip is a compact interactive label for lightweight actions, selections, and filters.

items.name: combo-box
items.title: ComboBox
items.description: Select combined with a text input: filter the option list and either pick an option or type a custom value.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: DatePicker is a single-date input that pairs a text-style trigger with a calendar popover.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker
items.description: DateRangePicker is a two-date input that pairs a text-style trigger with a calendar popover and an optional preset side panel.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A horizontal rule used to visually separate content sections.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: DropdownMenu is a floating menu anchored to a trigger that presents a short list of contextual actions or commands.

items.name: field-label
items.title: FieldLabel
items.description: FieldLabel is the label above a form control, with optional required marker and info tooltip.

items.name: file-item
items.title: FileItem
items.description: One file in a list — thumbnail, title, a secondary line, and the trailing control: a spinner while loading, the remove button once done, the warning icon on error.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: FileUpload
items.description: The upload trigger — a dropzone or a button — plus the hidden file input.

items.name: filter-button
items.title: FilterButton
items.description: FilterButton is a compact multi-select trigger that opens a checklist in a popup.

items.name: form-field
items.title: FormField
items.description: FormField wraps a control with its label and helper text.

items.name: helper-text
items.title: HelperText
items.description: HelperText is the hint or validation message under a form control.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: IconButton is an icon-only action for compact toolbars, utility controls, and dense interfaces where a full text label would add unnecessary visual weight.

items.name: illustration
items.title: Illustration
items.description: A line drawing for an empty state, a first run or an announcement: calendar, computer or folder, in two sizes.

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: InlineAlert
items.description: InlineAlert presents persistent, in-context feedback inside the current layout.

items.name: link-button
items.title: LinkButton
items.description: LinkButton preserves link semantics while applying button-like styling for navigation actions that need stronger visual emphasis.

items.name: list-item
items.title: ListItem
items.description: ListItem is a row in menus, selects and lists: leading slot, label, description, trailing slot.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Modal is a dialog for focused interactions that require user attention before continuing.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: A flexible multi-select dropdown built on Radix UI DropdownMenu.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination helps users move through a long collection of results one page at a time.

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup
items.description: Popup is a floating panel anchored to a trigger, built on Radix Popover.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: ProgressBar communicates the progress of a task or loading operation.

items.name: progress-stepper
items.title: ProgressStepper
items.description: A multi-step progress indicator that shows the user's position in a sequential workflow.

items.name: progress-tracker
items.title: ProgressTracker
items.description: A horizontal progress indicator made of coloured step segments.

items.name: radio-button
items.title: RadioButton
items.description: RadioButton lets users pick exactly one option from a set.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: ScrollArea adds styled, cross-browser scrollbars to overflowing content.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Deprecated: compose a search field from TextInput instead. Search is a TextInput with a fixed leading search icon and type="search" on the underlying input.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: SegmentedControl lets users pick one option from a compact horizontal group.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A flexible dropdown select component built on Radix UI primitives.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Sidebar is a collapsible vertical navigation panel.

items.name: sidepanel
items.title: Sidepanel
items.description: Sidepanel is an overlay panel that slides in from the left or right edge of the viewport.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An accessible slider built on Radix UI.

items.name: split-button
items.title: SplitButton
items.description: SplitButton is two independent interactive elements sharing a single visual unit: the left button triggers the primary action; the right icon button opens a dropdown menu.

items.name: spreadsheet
items.title: Spreadsheet
items.description: Spreadsheet is a dense grid of cells that people read, compare and work through one cell at a time.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: StatusBadge
items.description: StatusBadge is a small, non-interactive label used to convey status, category, or count at a glance.

items.name: status-modal
items.title: StatusModal
items.description: StatusModal is a dialog variant that communicates status through icon style, color accents, and layout orientation.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch is a binary toggle control — use it for settings that take immediate effect without a confirmation step.

items.name: system-alert
items.title: SystemAlert
items.description: SystemAlert is a full-width banner for app-level messages.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table displays structured data in rows and columns.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs organise content into named sections that the user can switch between without leaving the page.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Tag is a compact label used to categorize, classify, or annotate content with color-coded visual styles.

items.name: text-input
items.title: TextInput
items.description: A single-line text field for short free-form input (search, email, amounts, URLs).

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea is a multi-line text field for free-form input such as comments, descriptions, or messages.

items.name: thumbnail
items.title: Thumbnail
items.description: A small square tile that stands for a thing.

items.name: tile
items.title: Tile
items.description: Tile groups related information in a bordered container.

items.name: timepicker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: TimePicker lets the user pick a time from hour and minute selects.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast surfaces brief, non-blocking feedback about the result of a user action or system event.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip displays contextual information when a user hovers over or focuses a trigger element.

items.name: block-styles
items.title: Wideset block styles
items.description: Compiled layout utilities used by Wideset blocks.

items.name: block-kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: A project board: workspace sidebar, breadcrumbs and view tabs, filters, and columns of task cards.

items.name: block-process
items.title: Process
items.description: A creation flow: a workspace rail beside the sidebar, a step header with progress, and a choice of type.

items.name: block-finance-dashboard
items.title: Finance dashboard
items.description: An overview under a top bar: key figures, charts, a transactions table and a side panel.

items.name: block-spreadsheet
items.title: Spreadsheet
items.description: A table worked in cell by cell under a top bar: view tools, typed columns that sort, a summary under each header, row selection and a status bar.

items.name: block-gantt
items.title: Gantt
items.description: A plan over the app: a top bar to leave by, people and their tasks beside a timeline of months, and a task open in a side panel.

items.name: block-ai-chat
items.title: AI chat
items.description: An AI assistant home: a model switcher in the top bar, a greeting, and a composer with tools and attachments.

items.name: block-communication
items.title: Communication
items.description: A messaging app in three panels: the chat list, the conversation and the contact details.

items.name: block-calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month calendar on a raised page: views and filters in the header, events in the grid.

items.name: block-sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: A sign-in screen in two raised cards: the form, with its help links and keyboard hints, beside a picture of the product.

items.name: block-sign-in-card
items.title: Sign in card
items.description: The same sign-in form alone in one centred card, for a product with nothing to show beside it.

items.name: block-sign-up
items.title: Sign up
items.description: Creating an account in the sign-in card: name, work e-mail, a password you can reveal, and the terms.

items.name: block-crypto
items.title: Crypto
items.description: A wallet on a grey canvas: a swap form, the balance with a chart, transactions and a distribution.

items.name: block-analytics
items.title: Analytics
items.description: A product analytics overview: a period switch, four key figures with their change, a trend chart and the top pages.

items.name: block-sales-overview
items.title: Sales overview
items.description: Sales against target on a grey canvas: key figures with their progress to target, the pipeline by stage and the deals closing this month.

items.name: block-customers
items.title: Customers
items.description: A list of customers to work through: segment tabs, search and filters, a table with selection and actions on the selected rows.

items.name: block-customer-detail
items.title: Customer detail
items.description: One customer’s record on a raised page: a header with actions, key facts, tabs over open deals and an activity timeline.

items.name: block-billing
items.title: Billing
items.description: A workspace’s plan and usage on a raised page: usage against limits, the payment method, a failed payment to retry and the invoices.

items.name: block-invoice
items.title: Invoice
items.description: One invoice as a document on a raised page: who bills whom, the lines and totals, how it was paid, and downloading or sending it.

items.name: block-settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: Workspace settings: a list of sections beside forms for the profile, the workspace and notifications, and a danger zone.

items.name: block-team
items.title: Team
items.description: The people in a workspace: members with their roles, pending invitations and inviting someone new.

items.name: block-onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A first run on a raised page: a welcome, a setup checklist with progress, and the next best actions.

items.name: block-empty-list
items.title: Empty list
items.description: A list before its first record: an empty state that explains what will appear and how to add or import the first one, and the same list with no search results.

items.name: block-no-access
items.title: No access
items.description: A page the viewer may not open: who owns it, why it is closed and a way to request access.

items.name: block-not-found
items.title: Not found
items.description: A missing page before or outside the app: what happened and the ways back.

items.name: block-forgot-password
items.title: Forgot password
items.description: Resetting a password in the sign-in card: the e-mail field, then a confirmation that the link is on its way.

items.name: block-check-email
items.title: Check your e-mail
items.description: The sign-in card after a magic link was sent: where it went, how long it works, and resending it.

items.name: block-two-factor
items.title: Two-factor code
items.description: The second sign-in step in the sign-in card: a six-digit code, a trusted-device option and backup ways in.

items.name: block-sso-sign-in
items.title: Single sign-on
items.description: Signing in through an identity provider in the sign-in card: Google, Microsoft and a work e-mail for SAML.

items.name: block-accept-invite
items.title: Accept invitation
items.description: Joining a workspace from an invitation in the sign-in card: who invited you, the workspace and creating your account.

items.name: block-integrations
items.title: Integrations
items.description: A workspace’s integrations as a settings page: search and categories, the connected apps in a table with their status, the ones to add as tiles, and connecting one in a side panel.

items.name: block-plans
items.title: Plans
items.description: Choosing a plan over the app: monthly or yearly, three plans as cards side by side, and a feature comparison under them.

items.name: block-notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: An inbox of notifications: unread first, grouped by day, filters, and acting on one without leaving.

items.name: block-report
items.title: Report
items.description: A report on a grey canvas: a date range and an export above key figures, charts and a breakdown table, each in its own white section.

items.name: block-home
items.title: Home
items.description: A workspace home on a raised page: today’s tasks to tick off with their progress, the deals to move this week, the next meetings and recently opened records.

items.name: block-dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: A revenue dashboard on a raised page: a period control over four key figures with their change, a trend against the period before, revenue by owner and progress to the quarter’s goal, split by lines instead of cards.

items.name: block-page-states
items.title: Page states
items.description: A customer overview with its four modules in the four states a module can be in: loaded, loading, empty and failed with a working Retry, under one page-wide notice.

items.name: block-order-confirmation
items.title: Order confirmation
items.description: The page after a plan upgrade on a raised page: a centred confirmation with the next charge, the receipt, two next steps and the way back to the workspace.

items.name: block-checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Paying for a plan change on a raised page: the plan with seats and add-ons, the billing period, payment method and billing details as tiles, beside a summary with a promo code that reprices as the order changes.

items.name: block-send-payment
items.title: Send payment
items.description: Sending a payment on a raised page: one narrow card that is the form, then the review before anything moves, then the receipt, with recent transfers beside it and a confirmation only above a stated limit.

items.name: block-orders
items.title: Orders
items.description: The order history on a raised page: search, a status filter, a date range and a sort over a table that pages, each row opening its order, with a refund dialog from the row’s menu that changes its status.

items.name: block-order-detail
items.title: Order detail
items.description: One order on a raised page: its items and totals and the delivery timeline, each in a bordered card, the customer and addresses beside them, and refunding it from the header.

items.name: block-referrals
items.title: Referrals
items.description: A referral programme on a raised page: the deal in one line, the link to copy and an invite by e-mail, the credit earned and available beside progress to the next reward, the people invited with their status, and redeeming credit against the next invoice in a confirm dialog.

items.name: block-cancel-subscription
items.title: Cancel subscription
items.description: Cancelling a plan on a raised page, in one narrow column: what happens and what is lost, an optional reason, one alternative that fits it, and the only red button; then the result in place, with the way to undo it.

items.name: block-inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: Mail with customers on a raised page: a searchable list of conversations beside the open one, its earlier messages folded to a line, with archive, star and a reply in place.

items.name: block-chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Team chat on a raised page: channels and people in a narrow column, then the open thread grouped by day and sender, with a shared file, a quoted reply, reactions and the composer.

items.name: block-activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: A workspace feed on a raised page: a composer, the posts with their likes and comments split by lines, and who to follow beside them.

items.name: block-reviews
items.title: Reviews
items.description: Customer reviews on a raised page: the average and its spread, the reviews to filter, sort and answer, and a dialog to request one.

items.name: block-goals
items.title: Goals
items.description: Team goals on a raised page: each goal’s figure against its target with one bar, a judged state and key results to tick off, then the quarter’s leaderboard with your row marked “(you)” and the milestones reached, and a dialog to add a goal.

items.name: block-profile
items.title: Profile
items.description: A teammate’s profile on a raised page: who they are and their local time, Follow as the one filled button, followers and following that open a list, their open deals and recent activity beside how to reach them and what they reached this year.

items.name: block-access-requests
items.title: Access requests
items.description: Who gets into a workspace, on a raised page: requests to approve with a role or decline, one by one or in an action bar, invitations to resend or revoke, and the people blocked, each answer undoable from its toast.

items.name: block-account-settings
items.title: Account settings
items.description: A person’s own settings on a raised page, each section’s title beside its controls: profile and a verified e-mail, language and region, a theme that switches, notifications, sign-in and sessions, and deleting the account behind a typed confirmation.

items.name: block-help-center
items.title: Help center
items.description: Help inside the product on a raised page: a search that turns the page into its matches, the topics as tiles, popular articles and the ways to reach support.

items.name: block-article
items.title: Article
items.description: A help article on a raised page: the text in a reading column with steps, a note, a table and code, the contents following the scroll, whether it helped and what to read next.

items.name: block-lesson
items.title: Lesson
items.description: A course lesson on a raised page: the video with its chapters, the course outline with progress, and a short quiz at the end that completes the lesson.

items.name: block-recording
items.title: Recording
items.description: A call recording on a raised page: who spoke when, the transcript that follows the player, highlights and comments at a moment, and a voice note.

items.name: block-files
items.title: Files
items.description: A workspace’s shared files on a raised page: places and collections in a narrow column, files as a list or a grid with drawn previews, uploading in place, an action bar to move, copy, collect, archive or delete, and a trash to restore from.

items.name: block-gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: A template library on a raised page: categories as tabs beside the sort, featured collections, templates as cards with a drawn preview and a save toggle, and a side panel to add one to the workspace.

items.name: block-product-form
items.title: Product form
items.description: Adding a product to the catalogue on a raised page: details, photos with a cover, pricing with a live margin, options that make variants and inventory as cards, either beside its sales channels and a live preview (split) or alone in a centred column with the actions in a bar at the foot (centered).

items.name: block-import
items.title: Import
items.description: Importing customers from a CSV file in steps on a raised page: the file, matching its columns to fields, a review of what will change with a choice for duplicates, then the result in place, with exporting from the header.

items.name: block-event-detail
items.title: Event detail
items.description: One customer event on a raised page: the date beside the name, its facts in a quiet row, the answer to the invitation as the one filled control with a follow-up in place, the agenda as a timeline, and who is going beside it.

items.name: block-booking
items.title: Booking
items.description: Booking a customer meeting on a raised page from the time they shared: the meeting, a month of open days and the free times in your time zone side by side, the details with a way back to each choice, then the confirmation in both time zones.

items.name: block-call
items.title: Call
items.description: A video call inside the app on a raised page: the people as tiles on a dark stage with the speaker outlined, a control bar to mute, share and record, and notes, chat and people in a panel beside it.

items.name: block-assistant
items.title: Assistant
items.description: An assistant beside a record on a raised page: the deal on the left, and a conversation on the right that cites its sources and proposes a change to apply, which lands in the record and its activity.

items.name: block-workflow-builder
items.title: Workflow builder
items.description: Building an automation on a raised page: steps on a canvas joined by lines with a + to insert one, a condition that splits the flow, the selected step’s settings in a panel beside it, and a switch that turns the workflow on once every step is complete.

items.name: block-pipeline
items.title: Pipeline
items.description: A deal pipeline on a raised page: stages as columns of deal cards with each stage’s total, dragged between and within stages or moved from the keyboard, filtered by owner, close date and search.

items.name: block-code-editor
items.title: Code editor
items.description: Editing a script on a raised page: files beside the editor with line numbers and colouring, a test run with its output and problems, and saving or restoring a version.

items.name: block-new-password
items.title: New password
items.description: Choosing a new password in the sign-in card after a reset link: rules that tick as you type, a confirmation, and an expired link that sends a new one.

items.name: block-verify-email
items.title: Verify e-mail
items.description: Verifying the address after sign-up in the sign-in card: a six-digit code that checks itself, resending it after a cooldown, and changing the address.

items.name: block-signed-out
items.title: Signed out
items.description: The sign-in card after signing out: the accounts still signed in on this device to continue as, and signing in with another.

items.name: block-choose-workspace
items.title: Choose workspace
items.description: Choosing a workspace in the sign-in card after signing in: the workspaces with the last used marked, invitations to accept or decline, and creating a new one.

items.name: block-agent-chat
items.title: Agent chat
items.description: An agent workspace in Chat mode: chats on the left in project groups with their state, and one raised card with the transcript where the agent thinks, takes steps and answers, the composer with its tools and the model, and, behind a line, the document it writes.

items.name: block-agent-code
items.title: Agent code
items.description: An agent workspace in Code mode: sessions by repository, a transcript of the plan, steps, test runs and an approval waiting for a command, beside a pane with the changes, a terminal, a preview, the files, the tasks or the pull request’s checks.

items.name: block-agent-research
items.title: Agent research
items.description: A research run in Chat mode: the plan the agent follows, its steps folded to a few lines, and the report with a comparison table and numbered citations, beside the sources it read, behind a line; a citation lights its source and a source its citations.

items.name: block-agent-sessions
items.title: Agent sessions
items.description: Every Code session in one list to work through: a search and a filter by state, the sessions under their repositories with the state, branch, pull request and its checks, the last step and the run time, the ones that need you first and answered from the row, and Stop and Archive for a selection.

items.name: block-agent-states
items.title: Agent states
items.description: One Code session at the moments it has to handle, picked from the top bar: the usage limit reached, a step that failed, a connector to reconnect, a question from the agent, the context nearly full, the connection lost, messages waiting in the queue and a run you stopped, each shown where it happens with its way out.

items.name: block-task-sidepanel
items.title: Task side panel
items.description: A record’s detail beside the page: its properties, subtasks, tabs over an activity timeline, and keyboard hints.

items.name: block-modal-form
items.title: Form modal
items.description: A short form in a modal: its fields, a consent to tick, the actions in the footer and keyboard hints under them.

items.name: block-modal-stepper
items.title: Stepper modal
items.description: A setup in steps in a modal: the steps down the left with their state, the current step’s form beside them.

items.name: block-modal-details
items.title: Details modal
items.description: A record read in a modal: its key facts and actions, tabs over its history, and moving to the previous or next record.

items.name: block-modal-task
items.title: Task modal
items.description: A task opened in a modal: its properties and progress, subtasks to tick off, and tabs over the activity log.

items.name: block-modal-search
items.title: Search modal
items.description: Search across the workspace in a modal: the query, result tabs, and results to move through by keyboard.

items.name: block-modal-access
items.title: Access modal
items.description: Sharing in a modal: inviting by e-mail with a role, who has access and their roles, a private switch and the link.

items.name: block-media-viewer
items.title: Media viewer
items.description: A file opened full screen over the app: the file large in the middle with zoom, moving to the previous or next, its details and comments beside it, and closing back to its row.

items.name: block-command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: A command palette over the app: one field that finds pages, customers and deals and runs actions, grouped with their shortcuts, opened with Ctrl K.

items.name: block-account-menu
items.title: Account menu
items.description: The account menu opened from the sidebar: who is signed in, the workspaces, settings, a theme submenu, switching account and logging out.

items.name: block-notifications-popover
items.title: Notifications popover
items.description: Notifications in a popover from the bell: the latest grouped by day with unread dots, an access request answered in place, and the way to the full inbox.

items.name: block-coach-marks
items.title: Coach marks
items.description: A short guided tour over a real page: one mark at a time under the control it explains, that control ringed, with a step count, back, next and skipping, started again from the help menu.

items.name: block-whats-new
items.title: What’s new
items.description: What’s new in a dialog over Home: the latest update with a drawn sketch, what it does and why, trying it, and earlier updates that open in place.

items.name: block-filter-popover
items.title: Filter popover
items.description: Building a filter in a popover over a list: conditions of field, test and value joined by and or or, applied together and shown as removable chips, with the sort in a popover beside it.

items.name: block-confirm-delete
items.title: Confirm delete
items.description: Two weights of deleting on a list of reports: one report goes at once with Undo in a toast, a shared folder asks first in a dialog that says what goes with it and who loses access, and waits for its name.

items.name: block-report-dialog
items.title: Report dialog
items.description: Reporting a comment from the feed in a dialog: the comment quoted, a reason, optional details, blocking its author, then thanks and what happens next in place, and the comment hidden with Show anyway.

items.name: block-feedback-dialog
items.title: Feedback dialog
items.description: Feedback from the sidebar in a dialog: a five-step worded scale, a topic, a few words, a screenshot of the page shown as a thumbnail and consent to follow up, then thanks in place.

items.name: block-context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: A context menu on a customer row, opened by a right-click, its ⋯ button or Shift F10: open, copy and duplicate, assign and tag in submenus, archive with Undo, and delete last.

items.name: block-move-dialog
items.title: Move dialog
items.description: Moving files in a dialog: a searchable folder tree with the current folder marked, the chosen path under it, a new folder named in place, and moving or archiving, with Open folder and Undo after.

items.name: block-export-dialog
items.title: Export dialog
items.description: Exporting customers in a dialog: all, the filtered or the selected ones with their counts, the date added, the columns and the format, then the file prepared in place and downloaded, or e-mailed when it is large.

items.name: block-agent-context
items.title: Agent context
items.description: A session’s environment in a popover from the context meter in the composer: how full the context is and what fills it with a way to compact it, the connectors with the one to reconnect, the files and the document the session produced, and the pull request it opened.
